pairs.subject: fleet-orchestration
pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/sandbox.rs:721 status_from_disk reports any sandbox session dir without session.json as Failed. A session cut off by a daemon restart (no error.json, nothing self-reported) therefore reads the same as one that wrote its own error.json, which merges lost-at-recovery into self-reported failure.

techniques.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/sandbox.rs:721 Recovery honesty: a session found after a restart with no terminal record gets the self-reported Failed label. SandboxState has no lost or unknown member, and error.json is never consulted.

crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/sandbox.rs:705 A missing record gets a definite state (failed) when it should be passed through as unknown or interrupted. A Stopped session's session.json also reads back as Done.

crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/sandbox.rs:68 Identity comes from a second-resolution timestamp plus the length. Ids can recur, which is why start must move an existing dir aside. The closed vocabulary (Running/Closing/Judging/Done/Failed/Stopped) has no lost member, and set_state writes status directly with no transition door.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/sandbox.rs:353 One session at a time, never beside a live sim run. The slot is claimed at one door under the lock.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/sandbox.rs:568 A judge result that is pending, void, or decided zero hard checks becomes Unmeasured, never a pass. That is the three-valued verdict.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/sandbox.rs:375 A new session never inherits a predecessor's artifacts. The old dir is moved aside under a dated attempt tag, which keeps it as history.

crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/review/tagger.rs:365 The tagger fans out batches (PARALLEL_BATCHES) and accounts for every input line, tagged or untagged. engine_down separates total failure from partial failure.

pairs.subject: fleet-orchestration
pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/runs.rs:216 run_dirs drops every tournament run dir that has no transcript before it classifies or counts anything. A run whose prepare step failed (the sim writes only error.json, so it classifies as Failed, an is_result class) is neither loaded nor counted in Excluded, so it falls off the roster with no trace.

techniques.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/runs.rs:216 loaded + excluded does not account for the whole roster. A Failed run with no transcript (shadowrunr-sim runner.rs write_error after a prepare failure) vanishes, even though Excluded claims to count what was left out.
crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/runs.rs:164 A run with no terminal record is counted as incomplete, with no guess about whether it is alive or dead.

crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/verify.rs:1 The Reconciler's claims are checked parent-side in code (refs must resolve to real transcript lines, diffs are fenced away from constitution.md) before anything is stored.
crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/runs.rs:161 Earlier attempts' outputs are recognised as history and counted, never mixed into the live results.
crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/budget.rs:43 This is a token budget for one synthesis prompt, not a stopping rule for a model-driven loop.
